description: Escape hatch: direct call to any Yango Tech Retail B2B endpoint — for paths without a dedicated tool (orders/update, receipts/documents/upload, wms/picking/set-state, logistics/delivery/set-state, products-vat/*, pricelists/get|create, store-pricelist-links/*, 3pl/deliveries/*). Every endpoint of this API is a POST with a JSON body; pass a relative path like "b2b/v1/pricelists/get" and the body object. CAUTION: this tool can perform writes; 5xx/network errors are never retried for it.

body.description: JSON request body (defaults to {} — the API expects a JSON object on every call).

path.description: Relative API path, e.g. "b2b/v1/pricelists/get". Absolute URLs are rejected (SSRF guard).

name: raw_request
title: Raw Yango Tech Retail API call
